text:
incident-bot: PAGING — p99 streaming tail latency spike detected for /v1/stream (eu-west-1). p99=12.4s (>2s SLO). paging on-call.

oncall-ryan: I'll take it. seeing lots of socket stalls and 502s from streaming-proxy.

sre-ash: Confirmed. proxy write timeouts ~30s, worker CPU at 95%, backlog increasing. looks like client backpressure + proxy saturation.

eng-runtime-maya: Noted. any config changes recently? Recent rollout of chunking v2 yesterday — could be interaction with slow clients.

support-lina: Customer X (finance-prod) reporting stalled streams since 09:12 UTC, ~120 active sessions impacted. CS ticket T-4321 created.

pm-jorge: Customer SLA risk, please focus on remediation and keep me posted.

oncall-ryan: Starting mitigations: scaling streaming-proxy pool, enabling tighter chunk flush (temp), and increasing proxy write timeout. Running commands:
```
# scale proxies
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/streaming-proxy --replicas=18
# increase write timeout
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/streaming-proxy PROXY_WRITE_TIMEOUT=45
```

sre-ash: Scaling up now. also toggling `streaming.drop_slow_clients=true` on the proxy to avoid head-of-line stalls (hotfix).

eng-runtime-maya: Preparing a rollback of chunking v2 to v1 for streaming routes; will cutover via canary.

oncall-ryan: Applied drop flag and bumped replicas. Immediate trend: p95 down from 3.1s -> 1.9s, p99 still ~5.6s. client-side backlog dropping.

sre-ash: Observed several upstream keepalive resets from older clients. As a short-term measure, enabling aggressive keepalive pruning on LB.

support-lina: CS updated Customer X with mitigation steps and ETA ~15m. They acknowledged and asked for interim mitigation (no data loss reported).

eng-runtime-maya: Canary rollback complete for 10% of traffic to chunking v1. Monitoring for regressions.

oncall-ryan: After canary, p99 down to 2.2s. Rolling full rollback to v1 now.

incident-bot: ACTIONS LOGGED: scaled proxies -> 18, PROXY_WRITE_TIMEOUT=45, streaming.drop_slow_clients=true, chunking rollback started.

sre-ash: Full rollback complete. p99 now 1.6s, p95 0.9s. No further 5xx spikes.

pm-jorge: Great work. Please create an incident postmortem and include root cause hypothesis and mitigation plan for slow client detection.

oncall-ryan: Will file PM with timeline and follow-ups. Short summary:
- Root cause: interaction of chunking v2 + slow clients causing proxy worker saturation and head-of-line stalls.
- Mitigations applied: scaled proxies, drop-slow-clients flag, increased write timeout, rollback chunking v2.
- Customer impact: Customer X (~120 sessions) saw stalls up to ~30s, no data lost.

sre-ash: Recommend: automated detection for slow client window, graceful shedding policy, and limit chunk size. Will draft RFC.

support-lina: CS to follow up with customers in ticket T-4321; mark "incident_postmortem_required".

oncall-ryan: Incident declared resolved. will handoff to eng-runtime and SRE for follow-up. Closing paging.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — p99 back within SLO. Postmortem required.
